title: The logarithmic lower-bound conjecture for the Schemmel iteration function $R_2$
statement:
Let $R_2$ be the function introduced in the paper, and let $x$ be an odd integer greater than $3$. **The logarithmic lower-bound conjecture.**

$$
R_2(x)\geq \frac{\log \left(\frac{49}{15}x\right)}{\log 7}.
$$

The conjecture proposes a lower bound for the number of iterations measured by $R_2$. The paper gives numerical motivation and discusses upper bounds, but does not establish this lower bound.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.05426

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2015).
source_name: Colin Defant, “On Arithmetic Functions Related to Iterates of the Schemmel Totient Functions”, arXiv:1506.05426 (2015).
